exercises.title: Reach the King Row
exercises.instruction: Move your checker onto the far edge of the board.

feedback.initial: A man becomes a king when it reaches the farthest row from where it began.
feedback.success: Your checker reached the king row and is promoted to a king.
feedback.invalidDestination: Move diagonally forward onto the king row.

feedback.initial: Each side has its own king row: the far edge of the board.
feedback.selected: Move the white checker forward to its final row.
feedback.success: Correct. White promotes at the opposite edge from black.
feedback.invalidDestination: Move diagonally forward onto White's king row.

exercises.title: Capture into Promotion
exercises.instruction: Capture the white checker and reach the king row.

feedback.initial: A man can also reach the king row by capturing.
feedback.success: Correct. Your capturing man landed on the king row and is promoted.
feedback.invalidDestination: Capture the white checker and land on the far row.

feedback.initial: Watch what happens when a capture reaches the king row.
feedback.success: Your checker becomes a king, and the turn ends immediately. It does not continue capturing backward as a new king until a later turn.
feedback.invalidPiece: Choose the black checker with the compulsory capture.
feedback.invalidDestination: Jump the white checker onto the king row.

feedback.initial: Your other checker is close to promotion—but remember which rule comes first.
feedback.selected: Check the whole board before moving.
feedback.awaitingReply: Good capture. White makes its move.
feedback.success: Correct. Even when a checker is one move from becoming a king, a compulsory capture elsewhere takes priority.
feedback.invalidPiece: Another black checker has a compulsory capture.
feedback.invalidDestination: You must make the available capture before you can pursue promotion.
